exposure: Privacy during childbirth and hospital stay
cohort: 1004 postnatal Indian women at selected public health facilities in Chhattisgarh, India
finding: Although overall satisfaction with childbirth services was high, women who had vaginal births were least satisfied with processes around meeting their newborns, while those who had caesarean births were least satisfied with postpartum care.
mod_finding: Women who had vaginal births were least satisfied with processes around meeting their newborns, while those who had caesarean births were least satisfied with postpartum care.
